remarks: Welcome home to this beautiful 1-bedroom in-law apartment located in one of the most desirable neighborhoods around! Perfect for anyone seeking a peaceful retreat with easy access to city life, this charming space combines comfort and convenience. Ideal for professionals, the unit has its own separate entrance, in unit laundry, and private patio, you'll have the perfect space to relax or grill during the warm months. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity to live in one of the most coveted neighborhoods in the area! Unit is just shy of 1000 sqft, central air in living room only, window units for office(not pictured), and primary bedroom.  Please note: No Smokers(vaping included), No Pets, No More than 2 Occupants Max. Ideal tenant/s: working, credit above 650+, references, clear background/eviction history.  *Must have an agent for a showing*
